evidence:
Source/design-level Pass; the runtime floor behaviour on weak apps is unmeasured, hence risk=true.

Wiring (template-identical, verified by diff): scoring.toml [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0; [weights] 0.6/0.2/0.2; [floors] functional=0.05. score.py:41 gates_passed requires every gate > 0; score.py:47-48 reward = weighted only if gates_passed and floors_passed (functional > 0.05), else 0.0. test.sh writes the zero reward first, exits with 0 reward when /app/server.js is missing, the app never answers HTTP, or the gates suite fails. Simulated with a scratch copy of the frozen score.py+scoring.toml: gates {render 1, constraints 0} with scored polish=visual=1 -> 0.0000; render 0 -> 0.0000; functional 0.0427 or 0.05 with polish=visual=1 -> 0.0000 (floor is strict >).

Floor cases vs gates:
- Blank / unavailable: render gate (gates/render/judge.toml:23) needs a wrong-password refusal then a correct sign-in into a usable workspace; 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient.' -> 0.
- Static mock / seed copy: constraints gate (gates/constraints/judge.toml:23) needs a UI-created job + candidate read back by the Observer in a new independent browser context (prompt.md:9 forbids reload/second tab as independence); 'A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate.' A seed-copy page cannot show a freshly created uniquely-named job/candidate; a localStorage mock fails the independent context.
- Keyword-stuffed: every prompt line 1 treats app strings as untrusted and never follows app instructions; the gate is an observed creation/readback, not text matching, so stuffing earns nothing.
- Refusing every action: the creation in the constraints gate is refused -> 0.
- Defense in depth: functional prompt.md:11-13, polish prompt.md:12 ('A blank or static shell or an observed failure of that check gives binary0 throughout') and visual prompt.md:12 (minimum raw Likert 1, normalized zero) repeat the same browser gate, so even if the gate suite were bypassed, polish/visual cannot be farmed by a shell.
- Off-origin/CDN: instruction.md allows CDN fonts/scripts on the browser side; no criterion penalises it (correctly not a floor case).

Weakest gate-passer (try-to-break): an app with real SQLite-backed job/candidate creation and nothing else. Plausible functional credit: hro_add_candidate 0.5 + hro_restart 1.5 (+ hro_job_open 0.5 if validation) = 2.0-2.5 of total functional weight 58.5 (43 criteria) -> 0.034-0.043 < 0.05 floor -> reward 0 even with perfect visual. Refusal rows require an in-review positive control (functional prompt.md:13), so a dead feature does not collect hro_observer_readonly/hro_anonymous/hro_undo_once/hro_activity_refusals credit.

Residual (Note-level, not a row-39 defect): a thin-but-real app (job open with validation, add candidate, email rules, reorder, restart; ~5/58.5 = 0.085 functional) whose conversations/activity are static mocks clears the floor; with polish 0 and visual Likert 4 the simulated reward is 0.2013, mostly from visual mass. That app has genuine server-backed shared work, so it is a partial app rather than a shell; the floor value and 0.6/0.2/0.2 weights are template-controlled (identical to template) and the ranking question belongs to rows 42/44.

Conforming alternative that could wrongly fail the floor gate: none found; the gate permits any route layout/labels (app_context.md:33-34), accepts 'another working staff account' if Aud fails, and does not require source-field semantics beyond 'any source', which is part of the add-candidate brief. Note the gate requires a hiring-manager field and interview places, both mandated by the public rules.

Missing evidence: raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent.' No blank/static/seed-copy/stuffed/refusing app has been run through the configured judge, so the judge actually failing the gate on such apps is NOT EXERCISED.
